name: automation-engineering
description: Working toolkit and local reference for this estate's automation projects: Ignition (Perspective, tags, UDTs, scripts, gateway resources, historian), Node-RED flows, and the MQTT + SQL layers that connect them. Includes live gateway and broker tooling, cross-platform triage playbooks, and the shared pitfall knowledge base.

dev_gateway_url.title: Dev Ignition gateway URL
dev_gateway_url.description: Base URL of the non-production gateway that exposes the HTTP API and MCP server. This is the only gateway you can drive programmatically.

prod_gateway_hosts.title: Production gateway hostnames
prod_gateway_hosts.description: Comma-separated hostnames to treat as production. The bundled tooling refuses to send writes to these.

ign_api_token.title: Ignition API token
ign_api_token.description: Required only for WRITE operations and for the MCP server. Reads on the dev gateway work anonymously. Create one under Config > Security > API Tokens.

mqtt_host.title: MQTT broker host
mqtt_host.description: Broker for connectivity checks and topic discovery.

mqtt_username.title: MQTT username
mqtt_username.description: Broker username. Leave blank to connect anonymously.

mqtt_password.title: MQTT password
mqtt_password.description: Broker password, paired with the username above.
